No tasks run yet.

Tap a task button above. Each result will show four fields:

 Ran on — where the task executed:
 • Phone = ran on this device (no network call)
 • Edge = laptop on same Wi-Fi (low latency)
 • Cloud = remote server (more compute, higher latency)

 Took — total wall-clock time end-to-end. Lower = faster.

 Output — size of the returned result (bytes / KB / MB).

 Why — the planner's reasoning: which signals
 (network, battery, CPU, task size) drove the choice.

Tip: try the same task while toggling Wi-Fi or walking away from
the router. The planner should pick different targets as
conditions change — that is the self-adaptive behavior.
Tip: run `ipconfig` (Windows) or `ifconfig` (macOS/Linux) on the laptop to find its LAN IP. Both phone and laptop must be on the same Wi-Fi.
URL must start with http:// or https://
